mapper.select: SELECT * FROM nbpuask.conversation_shares WHERE share_id=#{shareId} AND share_available=TRUE LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM nbpuask.conversation_shares WHERE owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND share_available=TRUE ORDER BY CAST(share_created_time AS UNSIGNED) DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nbpuask.conversation_shares( share_id, conversation_id, owner_user_id, share_created_time, share_available, visit_count, last_visited_time ) VALUES ( #{shareId}, #{conversationId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{shareCreatedTime}, TRUE, 0, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE share_id=VALUES(share_id), owner_user_id=VALUES(owner_user_id), share_created_time=VALUES(share_created_time), share_available=TRUE, visit_count=0, last_visited_time=NULL
